players.name: Max Gawn
players.note: Gawn returned to the 100+ club with his 19 disposals and 47 hit outs. He was up against Edwards and Blicavs so we would have expected a bit more from him.

players.name: Harry Sheezel
players.note: Sheezel was just the complete player as we are used to. He ended with 29 at an incredible 93% efficiency with a goal. He is a must consider for C every week.

players.name: Zak Butters
players.note: Butters went down with a serious ankle injury and this has seen him go in for surgery and he will miss now through until at least round 24 where he is hoping to be back for the last round.

players.name: Nick Daicos
players.note: Nick did as he pleased with 39 disposals 7 clearances and a goal. He was instrumental in the Pies resurgence in the third term and made sure of the win with a great goal.

players.name: Brodie Grundy
players.note: Grundy was back to his very best against the young Giant ruckman. 29 hit outs and 23 disposals to go with a game equal high 7 clearances. A great option for us.

players.name: Nasiah Wanganeen-Milera
players.note: Nas just had a day out with 39 kicks 7 handballs 4 goals and 5 clearances. Simply amazing and he has to be considered for C every single week.

players.name: Marcus Bontempelli
players.note: Bont had a very quiet start to the game with just 36 points at the half way point. However a big last quarter of 41 revived his score. 29 touches and a couple of goals for the Dogs captain.

players.name: Bailey Smith
players.note: This wasn't one of his bigger games as he worked through it at a fairly even pace ending with 28 touches and 5 clearances. The last quarter was his best with 31 points coming from it.

players.name: Isaac Heeney
players.note: Heeney was tagged but still managed 25 disposals and a goal. It was also his first under 800 since round 13.

players.name: Luke Jackson
players.note: Jackson didn't have it all his own way as his lean run of scoring continues. Just 19 disposals at 63% for the Docker star with this his fourth in the 90s in a row.

players.name: Max Holmes
players.note: Holmes suffered an ankle injury in the second half as he finished with 23 disposals. He has been sent for surgery and will miss multiple weeks. If you have trades you need to move him on.

players.name: Tristan Xerri
players.note: Xerri has now been in the 70s in three of the last four which is a huge concern for owners.

players.name: Jordan Dawson
players.note: Dawson was tagged by Allen this week and had a great first term but then just 10 and 16 points in the last two quarters. He still had a goal and 22 touches with 7 tackles but 54% efficiency.

players.name: Errol Gulden
players.note: Gulden again showed that he is back to his very best as he posted 41 disposals and had 7 clearances to top score in the game. He will be a popular option for anyone needing a midfield replacement.

players.name: Zach Merrett
players.note: Merrett was one of two Bombers over 100 this week with 9 tackles and 22 disposals.

players.name: Lachie Neale
players.note: Neale did have 24 disposals but at just 66% efficiency which is why he didn't get a better score.

players.name: Ed Richards
players.note: Richards was the standout in this game with a couple of goals from his 32 disposals. He played the key role in the middle for the night.

players.name: Luke Davies-Uniacke
players.note: LDU was tagged by Boxshall and held to his lowest in the last 5 games. Just the 17 disposals at 82%.

players.name: Clayton Oliver
players.note: Clarry was one of the best for the Bombers despite giving away 4 free kicks. He led the team in Contested possessions with 15 and also clearances with 5.  He is having a great first season at GWS.

players.name: Jack Sinclair
players.note: Sinclair left the game early after just 1 handball as he injured his calf. He is listed as TBC on the injury report so unfortunatly he will need to be traded.

players.name: Noah Anderson
players.note: Anderson was the only Sun in triple figures this week with 9 marks and 30 disposals. Interestingly no tackles for him this week.

players.name: Will Ashcroft
players.note: Ashcroft was great with 30 touches a couple of goals and 7 marks. If you need to replace anyone in the mids then he is a perfect target.

players.name: Tim Taranto
players.note: 25 possessions for Taranto but just the 64% efficiency which did hurt his score.

players.name: Jai Newcombe
players.note: 28 for Newcombe at 71%. He was one of 9 Hawks to reach double figures in the game. A good bounce back from last week.

players.name: Bailey Dale
players.note: Dale was good for the Dogs with 29 disposals and 6 marks but he did come off in the last few minutes of the game looking sore but he should be ok. He also had the Murdock forward tag.

players.name: Callum Wilkie
players.note: Again Wilkie has been held below 100. This was better than last week but not by much with 9 marks and just 15 disposals. He has had to be more responsible with no Sinclair and he can't just free wheel like he was.

players.name: Lachie Whitfield
players.note: Whitfield took 11 marks and had 26 touches but 5 clangers and just 1 of his possessions contested is why his game didn't translate into a big score.

players.name: Luke Parker
players.note: Parker bounced back last week and even though he didn't crack triple figures it was still the third highest score for the Roos from his 25 disposals.

players.name: Lachie Ash
players.note: Ash took 8 marks and was one of 5 Giants over 100 with his 26 touches. Still a solid contributor to your back line.

players.name: Tim English
players.note: English had his hands full with Nank but a goal and 6 marks to go with 13 touches and 27 hit outs saw him have the fourth highest score for the Dogs.

players.name: Wayne Milera
players.note: A very popular trade in for Holmes this week and he did well before a very quiet last term as the Pies took over. He did have a slight injury concern at the end of the game but should be ok to go this week.

players.name: Jason Horne-Francis
players.note: Coming back from his suspension we saw JHF be by far and away the best for the Power in the midfield with 15 contested 7 clearances and 30 disposals. He is the main man at the moment so would be the first in line for a tag.

players.name: Caleb Serong
players.note: Serong had an equal team high 7 clearances to go with 25 disposals and 6 marks. He is on a bit of a hot streak of late and comes at a good price.

players.name: John Noble
players.note: Noble was a hot contender to come into sides for Holmes this week but his 18 disposals included 6 clangers and his score was his lowest of the season.

players.name: Sam Walsh
players.note: Walsh posted his third 120+ in a row and fourth in the last five. He is really hitting a great run of form and racked up 31 touches this week.

players.name: Archie Roberts
players.note: Despite the score he was the third highest score for the Bombers in the big loss. He used his 21 disposals well going at 85%

players.name: Sam Berry
players.note: 19 tackles and 29 disposals with a fantastic game for Berry.

players.name: Bodhi Uwland
players.note: After a great run of four over 110 we have now seen three under 85 in a row from Bohdi as the Suns struggle for form.

players.name: Jordon Sweet
players.note: Big test for Sweet today against Jackson but he posted another good score from 11 possessions and 31 hit outs. He is having a great second half of the season.

players.name: George Hewett
players.note: Hewett has been up and down with his scoring this season and isn't showing what we saw in previous years. However he was one of just two Blues over 100 this week. Hold if you have him.

players.name: Andrew Brayshaw
players.note: Not a huge score for Brayshaw but it keeps his 90+ streak since the bye going. 25 touches and 7 tackles went with his 4 clearances. He is an option if you need one but there are others cheaper.

players.name: Nick Blakey
players.note: 24 touches and a goal for Blakey. He has had three good weeks in a row now and is going to be considered by anyone needing a defender replacement.

players.name: Finn Callaghan
players.note: Callaghan had the Jordon tag before leaving the game late with an ankle issue. His SuperCoach season is done now as he is having surgery on that ankle which will lead to a 10+ week recovery.

players.name: Zac Bailey
players.note: 3 goals for Bailey from his 26 disposals. This is now 6 over 100 in a row.

players.name: Patrick Cripps
players.note: Cripps ended with a great stat line of 30 disposals and 21 contested possessions and 15 clearances.  This is four 110+ now in the last six games for him as he is making a solid run to the end of the season.

players.name: Christian Petracca
players.note: Petracca was better this week but still not scoring to the levels that many were expecting him to have. He had 26 disposals but just 7 were kicks. He is a concern but we don't have the trades to move him on.

players.name: Kysaiah Pickett
players.note: Pickett was hot early with 37 in the first term but after that he had the Mullin tag applied and he had 37 for the rest of the game as he finished with 14 touches and a goal.

players.name: Callum Mills
players.note: Mills was a popular pick up for Holmes and had the 21 disposals. This was his first under 100 though since round 13.

players.name: Matt Rowell
players.note: Rowell was the third highest scoring Sun this week with 15 contested and 9 clearances but 6 clangers and 4 free kicks against really hurt his scoring.

players.name: Dayne Zorko
players.note: 11 marks for Zorko and he also had 27 kicks amongst his 34 disposals. A great game for him and his best since opening round.

players.name: James Sicily
players.note: Sicily made the most of the matchup with 10 marks and 27 disposals with 5 being intercept possessions.

players.name: Chad Warner
players.note: Warner was great for the Swans with his 32 disposals and goal. He is having a great season and is proving to be a great selection.

players.name: Josh Treacy
players.note: Treacy had a poor night with just the 1 goal from 9 disposals. He has been far too inconsistent for us. He is a risk but just know what you are playing on field.

players.name: Jack Ross
players.note: Ross came back into the side with immediate impact having 26 disposals and 4 tackles.

players.name: Jack Steele
players.note: Steele racked up 30 touches and led the game with 12 contested possessions. He got off to a hot start with 42 in the first but just 11 in the last when the game was there to be won.

players.name: Josh Worrell
players.note: Worrell has had now 4 games over 100 for the season with another great game this week. 11 marks and 28 disposals at 92% as he is putting his hand up for a spot in our teams.

players.name: Caleb Daniel
players.note: 6 marks and 24 disposals for Daniel this week. He used the footy well going at 91%.

players.name: Shai Bolton
players.note: Bolton had just the 18 disposals but did have 7 clearances on the night following his rest last game.

players.name: Josh Daicos
players.note: Daicos was quiet with his 15 touches this week. He went into the game with an injury cloud so a big score wasn't expected.

players.name: Will Day
players.note: Day hit the ton with his two goals and 21 disposals. A good return after his week off.

players.name: Tom Stewart
players.note: Stewart was the top scorer in the game with 11 of his 25 touches being intercepts. This was his third best score of the season.

players.name: Bradley Hill
players.note: On the back of two big games Hill was a popular pick  this week but had just the 24 disposals at 75% in the loss to the Cats.

players.name: Izak Rankine
players.note: Rankine went head to head with Daicos at the centre bounces and ended with 25 touches 6 clearances and 14 contested possessions. A great performance and with the Bombers and Tigers in the next two would be a great pickup .

players.name: Jordan Clark
players.note: Clark copped the defensive tag from Murdock this week and he was held to his second lowest score of the season so far from his 18 disposals.

players.name: Tom Liberatore
players.note: Libba was concussed again and will now miss this week's game.

players.name: Harley Reid
players.note: Reid got a little fiery early but settled to end with 30 disposals and he led the game in contested possessions with 15 and clearance with 12 but 10 clangers was part that really hurt his score.

players.name: Darcy Cameron
players.note: Cameron has gone from strength to strength in recent weeks with a huge 154 this week form his 9 tackles 23 disposals and 37 hit outs. He had an equal high 18 contested possessions and he had 6 clearances.

players.name: Touk Miller
players.note: Huge game for Touk with 27 handballs to go with 12 kicks and he led the game in clearances with 9. His first over 100 since round 13 and he did it in a big way.

players.name: Luke Ryan
players.note: Ryan was the best scorer in the game with 10 marks in the wet to go with 23 kicks and a couple of handballs. By far his best this season so don't jump on yet until we see another good score.

players.name: Sam Flanders
players.note: An achillies injury to Flanders will see him miss the rest of the season and be another forced trade for us this week.

players.name: Ryley Sanders
players.note: This is two quieter games in a row for Sanders after his return. Just the 15 disposals.

players.name: Josh Dunkley
players.note: 14 tackles certainly boosted Dunkley's score this week as he had just the 17 disposals. First back to back scores over 100 for him this season.

players.name: Tom McCarthy
players.note: 26 disposals for McCarthy for his best in the last five weeks. It was the efficiency of 92% that really helped his score along.

players.name: Marcus Herbert
players.note: Herbert was a huge surprise this week. He has been scoring well but really showed us what he can do with 36 disposals 8 marks and an 86% efficiency rating! He is one that you can play on field where needed but also if you are able to loop him at all then that is a great option.

players.name: Rowan Marshall
players.note: Marshall was withdrawn from the game with back spasms just 5 minutes before the game started. With TDK back then he may need to be traded out as it will hurt his scoring.

players.name: Bailey J. Williams
players.note: Williams put up a good showing against Jackson and Cox ending with a handy 26 hit outs and 12 disposals.

players.name: Darcy Wilmot
players.note: Wilmot continues his good run with 9 marks and 26 disposals.

players.name: Jayden Short
players.note: Short had plenty of the footy with 15 marks and 26 disposals but his score wasn't as high thanks to just 2 of those being contested possessions.

players.name: Murphy Reid
players.note: Reid had a solid game and it was an important bounce back after last week's low score. He ended with 26 touches at 88% with a goal. This is more the range of scoring we should expect from him.

players.name: Jarman Impey
players.note: Impey was the star this week for the Hawks with12 marks and 37 disposals at 81% efficiency. This is back to back over 130 for the defender.

players.name: Rory Laird
players.note: Laird left the game in the second term with an ankle issue and didn't return. Reports are that he will miss 3-4 weeks.

players.name: Jagga Smith
players.note: Jagga went big this week with 31 disposals at 90% and took 7 marks. His biggest score of the season and fifth over 100. Many have had to hold him as F6 and that is paying off in recent weeks.

players.name: Justin McInerney
players.note: McInerney left the game in the second term with a hamstring injury and is going to miss 8-10 weeks. Trade.

players.name: Harris Andrews
players.note: Andrews will be missing until Gather round after an errant swinging arm has seen him suspended for 3 games.

players.name: Lachlan McAndrew
players.note: McAndrew was good against Cameron but did give away 5 free kicks to go with 8 tackles and his 39 hit outs.

players.name: Scott Pendlebury
players.note: Pendlebury showed why he is still a dangerous player with 43 disposals and 10 marks to go with 2 goals.

players.name: Kieren Briggs
players.note: Briggs was huge with 51 hit outs 13 contested touches and 19 disposals as he took advantage of the favourable Geelong matchup

players.name: Nick Watson
players.note: 3 goals for Watson from his 14 disposals in the huge win.

players.name: Dan Houston
players.note: Houston again suffered with Howe back in the side. Just the 13 disposals and 5 tackles for him. His highlight was one of his 5 tackles being a run down chase that resulted in a Pies goal.

players.name: Connor Macdonald
players.note: Connor had the 9 marks to go with his 26 disposals. However it was his lowest in the last three. There was a big spread of scores this week for the Hawks.

players.name: Sam Durham
players.note: Durham gave away 3 free kicks amongst his 7 tackles and 14 disposals this week. All the Bombers struggled to score with just two over 80 so nothing to worry about.

players.name: Deven Robertson
players.note: Dev Rob was back this week and had the third best score for the Eagles but he left the game late with a knee issue which was iced up. It has been revealed he has torn an ACL and now will miss the rest of the season. Trade.

players.name: Noah Mraz
players.note: Mraz was solid and posted a handy 17 disposals at an impressive 94% efficiency. He has been great since coming into the team.

players.name: George Wardlaw
players.note: Wardlaw did a hamstring in the last quarter and looks set to spend more time on the sidelines.

players.name: Darcy Parish
players.note: Parish did have 17 disposals but there were 6 clangers which didn't help and he finished with his second below 40 in a row.

players.name: Oliver Dempsey
players.note: Looking like a elevating his game as he top scored for the Cats with no CBAs in the game against the Suns.

players.name: Elijah Tsatas
players.note: Tsatas continued his good run of scoring with a 22 possession game. If he keeps scoring like this he will be one to possibly hold through his bye as good bench cover.

players.name: Joe Richards
players.note: Richards relished the midfield time with the regular Power stars out of the side. He top scored for Port with his 31 disposals 8 tackles and goal. He is now going to miss 3-4 weeks with a finger injury.

players.name: Tanner Bruhn
players.note: Bruhn was amongst the best for the Cats with his 27 disposals at 81% efficiency.  A good return to the team from him.

players.name: Toby Greene
players.note: Greene left the game with a quad injury and we saw him during the second half with an ice pack on his leg. He is now going to miss a couple of weeks.

players.name: Nic Newman
players.note: This was Newman's lowest score for the season with his 21 disposals conceding 3 free kicks against.

players.name: Jack Ginnivan
players.note: Ginnivan left the game before half time with back soreness and we didn't see him again.

players.name: Jack Gunston
players.note: Gunston booted 5 from 8 kicks this week. He did as he pleased but don't expect this each week.

players.name: Connor Rozee
players.note: Rozee looked good until he hyper extended his leg in the third term and didn't return to the game and is now looking at a significant stint on the sidelines with tendon damage to the hamstring. A must trade.

players.name: Marc Pittonet
players.note: Pittonet returned but was no match for De Koning and Marshall registering his worst of the season.

players.name: Colby McKercher
players.note: Colby was forward and in the middle this week and had the 19 touches with 7 marks. But the score just isn't where we need it to be.

players.name: Willem Duursma
players.note: Duursma kicked a goal from his 14 disposals but his efficiency of 50% did hold his scoring back.

players.name: Brent Daniels
players.note: Another injury for Daniels with a calf this week which will see him spend time on the sidelines yet again. A cruel blow for him and the coaches that have brought him in on the back of some great form in recent weeks.

players.name: Ollie Wines
players.note: Wines is missing through suspension until round 3.

players.name: Hayden Young
players.note: Young was back in the side again  and was solid with 20 disposals and a goal. We just need his body to hold up for the run home.

players.name: Sam Lalor
players.note: Lalor kicked a goal from his 16 disposals. His scoring has been very consistent this season.

players.name: Riley Bice
players.note: Big game for Bice to be the second highest scorer of the game.

players.name: Riley Thilthorpe
players.note: Thilthorpe was suspended for a week so will miss the next two rounds with the bye in there. It could do him some good as he still doesn't look like he is operating at 100%.

players.name: Gryan Miers
players.note: Miers didn't back up that big score from last week as he finished with just the 13 disposals after having the tag from Tholstrup. He didn't touch the ball in the first term.

players.name: Josh Rachele
players.note: Rachele was good with the score involvements but just 7 disposals at 57%. He would be one you would upgrade if you had luxury trades available.

players.name: Marcus Windhager
players.note: It looks like Windhager's first two games may have been an anomaly. He did have 19 disposals at a lowly 52% which was what hurt his score.

players.name: Andrew McGrath
players.note: McGrath suffered a broken jaw and will now be missing for some time.

players.name: Adam Cerra
players.note: Cerra's second game was better than the first with 7 tackles included but he isn't doing enough to make us consider him.

players.name: Finn O'Sullivan
players.note: Finn returned to the side and scored well with his 85 from his 13 disposals. He is a bench option for you at best.

players.name: Tom De Koning
players.note: TDK had the sole ruck duties for most of the game with Marshall leaving the game with concussion. We don't really know what their true roles will be from that but TDK is probably still not a first choice for your ruck line.

players.name: Dylan Stephens
players.note: Stephens scores have been too up and down for us to consider him a solid own. His value went up this week but he won't move a great deal more with scores like this.

players.name: Jye Caldwell
players.note: Caldwell was one of the best for the Bombers and this was his best score for the year and just second over 100.  It would be worth seeing some consistency before jumping on.

players.name: Sam Draper
players.note: Draper hasn't been over 90 now in the last four games and isn't one that you want to be running in your ruck position.

players.name: Jaspa Fletcher
players.note: Jaspa had one out of the box with his 10 marks and 27 disposals. Is this the break out game that will spark his run. Keep an eye on him.

players.name: Josh Lindsay
players.note: 15 touches with 12 being kicks for Lindsay. His BE was huge and won't come down too much after this one so He is still on your trade out list.

players.name: Ben Miller
players.note: Miller took 9 marks and that resulted in 16 kicks and 1 handball going at 94%. His first under 100 for the last three games. He is still looking to be a good option for us.

players.name: Jarrod Witts
players.note: Witts was much better this week against the inexperienced Bomber rucks.

players.name: Sam Darcy
players.note: Darcy left the game in the second as his knee went underneath him. He has injured his ACL and will miss the season.

players.name: Hugo Hall-Kahan
players.note: Many played HHK on field or looped him for Holmes and he delivered us a 54 from his 19 disposals which came at just 68% efficiency. No need to move him on but loop where you can.

players.name: Darcy Fogarty
players.note: Fogarty put up 4 goals and was the difference in the win but has been suspended for 3 weeks for a high hit on Cunningham.

players.name: Jeremy Cameron
players.note: Cameron came from the field in the last term with a shoulder injury and now looks set to miss 4-6 weeks.

players.name: Shaun Mannagh
players.note: Mannagh had a night with 5 goals and 30 disposals. He has been up and down over the last few weeks and has posted some really low scores. We need to see consistency before we look to pick him up.

players.name: Reuben Ginbey
players.note: Ginbey injured a quad just as he was looking good. Must trade.

players.name: Charlie Curnow
players.note: 5 goals for Curnow with this just his fourth score over 100 for the year.

players.name: Jai Serong
players.note: Serong managed just the 12 disposals in the tight contest and his score now means it is four under 80 in the last four weeks. So bench cover for you at most.

players.name: Keidean Coleman
players.note: Coleman did a hamstring early in the game and had just 6 disposals. He is now going to miss a number of weeks and is a trade.

players.name: Charlie Cameron
players.note: 2 goals but just the 8 disposals. This was Charlie's lowest in the last four. His scoring can be quite up and down.

players.name: Brayden Cook
players.note: After a couple of good scores we saw Cook managed this week. Hold him as he should be back.

players.name: Hugh McCluggage
players.note: Massive for Hugh with his 29 disposals which included 14 contested. This is what we were thinking we would see from him this year.

players.name: Rory Lobb
players.note: Lobb played in the ruck in the absence of English and made the most of it with 30 hit outs and 17 disposals.

players.name: Logan Morris
players.note: 7 goals for Morris as he had 17 kicks and no handballs with 9 marks.

players.name: Milan Murdock
players.note: Murdock was tagging Clark this week and in doing so had just 3 kicks but 11 handballs. He isn't a great option on field like he was early in the season.

players.name: Jacob Farrow
players.note: Farrow finished the day with 21 disposals at 81%. His score was the 5th best for Essendon.

players.name: Joe Fonti
players.note: Fonti is dropping in value with this score being well below his BE. He is one you may want to move out if you can.

players.name: Oliver Francou
players.note: Francou left the game after catching a boot to the kneecap which caused him to be stretchered off in the last quarter. He will miss a few weeks with this now.

players.name: Elliot Yeo
players.note: Yeo was out of the game just before half time with a groin issue which is a real concern. If you have him then you need to trade him.

players.name: Patrick Retschko
players.note: This was his lowest in the last 5 games. We have seen some wild variations in his scoring but this is what we get with rookies so the best option is if you can loop him.

players.name: Xavier Lindsay
players.note: Lindsay has posted two solid scores now and is likely to rise nicely after his third game.

players.name: Joel Fitzgerald
players.note: Fitzgerald had the 19 at 68% which was a great turnaround from last week and inconsistency is what we are going to get from our rookies.

players.name: Oliver Hollands
players.note: Ollie was the top scorer for the Blues with a solid efficiency of 87% for his 23 disposals and 9 marks. His scoring is too erratic though to be one we need to get in.

players.name: Jedd Busslinger
players.note: Buslinger's third game didn't deliver as those that brought him in had hoped. His score was about half of his average from the first two and his BE has now risen to 17.

players.name: Jarrod Berry
players.note: Berry was the top scorer in the game and best with 31 disposals and 10 marks. He has had one good and one poor score before this so he isn't a solid play just yet.

players.name: Connor Budarick
players.note: Budarick had his equal highest in the last three but still fell well short of his BE which remains high. He is one we should be upgrading.

players.name: Daniel Curtin
players.note: Curtin was the top scorer for the Crows starting on the wing this week. 26 disposals and 14 contested possessions.

players.name: Dylan Moore
players.note: Great kick after the siren for Moore to tie the game but he had just 1 contested possession to go with his 18 disposals. This was his second poor score in a row.

players.name: Christian Salem
players.note: Salem left the game with an ankle injury so time to trade if you have him.

players.name: Miles Bergman
players.note: Bergman was the top scorer for the Power with his second solid game in a row with 11 marks for his 21 disposals. With Butters and JHF out he could pick up the extra mid time and points.

players.name: Mitch Georgiades
players.note: Mitch could have kicked 9 goals but was inaccurate with 4.6 on the night.

players.name: Ned Reeves
players.note: Reeves had a poor night despite 24 disposals Just 5 disposals.

players.name: Mattaes Phillipou
players.note: Phillipou has had a good stretch of games. 25 disposals at 72% and hit 100+ for the second time in the last three games.

players.name: Aaron Naughton
players.note: 6 goals for Naughton in a very impressive display.  Just beware that he can have a very wide range of scoring week to week.

players.name: Angus Sheldrick
players.note: Sheldrick needs to be traded out as he missed his BE by some distance.

players.name: Patrick Voss
players.note: Voss slotted 4 goals from 20 touches and 10 marks as he has put up three good scores now in the last four weeks.

players.name: Stephen Coniglio
players.note: Cogs was the top scoring Giant thanks to his 3 goals on the night.

players.name: Will Brodie
players.note: Brodie played his first game for the Power in the midfield and got 28% CBA. He had 4 kicks and 14 handballs. Job security isn't fully there with Wines collecting over 30 disposals in the SANFL. Wait another week at least.

players.name: Jack Lukosius
players.note: Lukosius returned to the side this week and looked good until a calf injury sidelined him and he looks set to miss more time.

players.name: Bailey Humphrey
players.note: Not a great night for Humphrey with just the 9 disposals and he gave away 3 free kicks.

players.name: Phoenix Gothard
players.note: Had a dislocated shoulder in the last term but did have just the 8 possessions to that time.

players.name: Jacob Hopper
players.note: Hopper just couldn't get going and he doesn't look to be an option for us despite 18 disposals.

players.name: Dyson Sharp
players.note: Sharp was the top scoring Bomber this week thanks to his 8 tackles and 21 disposals. He has put a couple of good weeks together now.

players.name: Cooper Trembath
players.note: Back to back in the 90s is making us sit up and have a look at Trembath. But don't go making any moves to get him in unless you think he can continue with this form.

players.name: Sam Banks
players.note: Just 11 touches for Banks with his lowest score since his return in round 12.

players.name: Elijah Hollands
players.note: Best of the season for Hollands with his 25 disposals and 2 goals. Just beware that his other two scores have been in the 60s.

players.name: Harvey Langford
players.note: Langford had a huge week by his standards. A good week for owners but we want to see another game like this before we jump on.

players.name: Liam Reidy
players.note: With Pittonet back we saw Reidy dropped this week.

players.name: Samuel Cumming
players.note: Two solid scores in a row for Cumming but trusting him on the ground in this Tigers outfit is a risky business. A great loop option though.

players.name: Patrick Dangerfield
players.note: Danger kicked 5 for his big score but his scoring has been rather inconsistent.

players.name: Tom Blamires
players.note: Blamires posted just 13 disposals and missed his BE by some distance and has lost value. If he retains his spot in the side he must be traded.

players.name: Sullivan Robey
players.note: Robey was carried off in the third with a knee issue. He will miss this week with a partial medial ligament tear. Sounds like he could miss more than a couple though.

players.name: Jake Riccardi
players.note: Riccardi is being used as a ruck more around the ground by the Giants with the new rules really helping him.

players.name: Jack Carroll
players.note: Carroll has had very up and down scoring over recent weeks and this was one of the better ones which will help his BE but importantly it helps us during these bye rounds.

players.name: Caleb Windsor
players.note: This is three under 60 in a row for Windsor who is not a player you can start on the field with any confidence. Just the 14 disposals.

players.name: Harry Rowston
players.note: Unfortunately Rowston wasn't the starting  pick that we had hoped for. Time to move away from him if you are still holding.

players.name: Michael Sellwood
players.note: Sellwood had his best score for a few weeks from his 7 marks and 14 disposals.

players.name: Jamie Elliott
players.note: Elliot suffered an ACL injury and will now miss the remainder of the season.

players.name: Leonardo Lombard
players.note: Many coaches still have Lombard and he didn't help them this week. His 13 disposals came at just 53% efficiency for his second lowest this season.

players.name: Josh Lai
players.note: Lai had his lowest score and he now has a BE of 28 which isn't what we want to see.

players.name: Lachie Jaques
players.note: Jaques is a must upgrade with his BE now up at 77 and this week he had just the 11 disposals and 4 marks.

players.name: Harry Dean
players.note: Dean had the job on Ben King and had 13 disposals in the process. Not a huge score but at this stage you are looping him or using him as the emergency.

players.name: Sam Swadling
players.note: Swadling's second game wasn't quite as great as his first with just 8 disposals although all were effective. The issue was the 59% time on ground.

players.name: Kye Annand
players.note: Annand with 10 disposals and 4 marks. He had the role on Naughton for the night.

players.name: Wade Derksen
players.note: Derkson is on many benches and many coaches would have tried to loop him on this week with his best score. 18 touches and 8 marks.

players.name: Campbell Lake
players.note: Lake posted a big game with 8 tackles to go with a goal and 17 disposals. Owners should be looking to loop him in the run home if he continues this form.

players.name: Archie Perkins
players.note: Roberts had his first under 100 since round 1 in the wet conditions. He had 30 disposals which is down on what he has been doing but still good. Nothing to be concerned about.

players.name: Angus Anderson
players.note: 13 disposals for Anderson as he hangs in there with some middle of the road scores. Not one to trade out.

players.name: Dante Visentini
players.note: We've seen two games from Dante in a row now and this one was much better with 22 hitouts and 10 disposals but the Cats lost both rucks early in the game which helped.

players.name: Zeke Uwland
players.note: Just 9 disposals for Zeke and it was his third score in the 20s this season.

players.name: Arthur Jones
players.note: Quiet day for Jones with just the 9 disposals at 55% efficiency and a goal.

players.name: Charlie Banfield
players.note: Banfield didn't back up that big score from the previous week having just the 7 disposals at 57%. Hopefully it is enough that he can hold his spot as we will need him over the byes.

players.name: Bailey Macdonald
players.note: Bailey wasn't able to take advantage of the matchup and had just the 12 disposals for the game. He hasn't been putting up big scores since the bye.

players.name: Conor McKenna
players.note: Unfortunately he dropped back to his mid 50s scoring this week despite 2 goals. This is going to happen with his game on occasion.

players.name: Samuel Grlj
players.note: Those still holding Grlj need to move him on. Just the 6 disposals this week.

players.name: Jack Dalton
players.note: First game for Dalton with 10 disposals. Nothing here that tells us that we can rely on him for scoring.

players.name: Mitchell Edwards
players.note: Edwards returned to the team this week and had the 8 touches and 28 hit outs. He is one you should be upgrading.

players.name: William Edwards
players.note: Just 5 disposals for Edwards who missed his already low BE. This has seen his new BE rise to 55 which is a big concern for owners.

players.name: Jasper Alger
players.note: 2 goals really saved Jasper's score as he had just 9 disposals.

players.name: Jordan Ridley
players.note: Ridley left the game in the second term. Another injury unfortunately for him with a foot issue.

players.name: Jack Ison
players.note: This is the best we have seen from Ison since round 11. 14 disposals for him but he is bench cover only.

players.name: Jai Murray
players.note: Murray's second game was a fruitful one with 19 disposals. The problem is his price as a downgrade isn't ideal with there being better options at $99k.

players.name: Max Gruzewski
players.note: A dislocated patella will likely see Max miss significant time.

players.name: Lachlan Blakiston
players.note: Blakiston made his BE this week but isn't setting the game alight. He is one you could hold as he will certainly get a game but any opportunity to upgrade should be considered.

players.name: Flynn Perez
players.note: Solid for Perez and this is about what you would expect to get from him most weeks.

players.name: Oscar Steene
players.note: Steene was rucking solo against Grundy but went off with a knee injury after just 12 disposals and 5 hit outs. He could be missing for a while. Time to trade.

players.name: Oliver Hayes-Brown
players.note: First game for Hayes-Brown as the Tigers were running out of rucks. An ok first game but once some of the others come back he will be gone from the side.

players.name: Todd Marshall
players.note: Marshall was back in the side this week but just the 5 touches and 4 marks for him. Not a score you would have wanted on field

players.name: Zane Zakostelsky
players.note: ZZ was a late inclusion for Fort which hurt a number of teams who used him as a Loop captain this week. He rose in value which is what we have been waiting for.

players.name: Cooper Duff-Tytler
players.note: CDT left the game in the last term with some calf tightness. Just the 6 disposals and 6 hit outs before that.

players.name: Mitch Podhajski
players.note: The Lachie Schultz injury may open the door for Mitch to come back into the side this week if Lachie misses games.

players.name: Harry Kyle
players.note: Second game for Kyle and both scores have been over 50 and he has a BE of -30. Could be a handy downgrade but he is more expensive than most other rookie downgrade options.

players.name: Charlie Edwards
players.note: Edwards dropped down from last week's score with just 12 disposals and only 6 were effective. With a BE of -24 he is still one you could downgrade to but that 39 does ring some alarms..

players.name: Malcolm Rosas
players.note: A badly rolled ankle saw Rosas day end early. Just 2 kicks and 2 tackles and he will now likely be missing some time. Even without that his BE is at 138. Trade him as soon as you can.

players.name: Harry Schoenberg
players.note: Shoenberg had 12 disposals but not enough points came from them.

players.name: Christopher Scerri
players.note: Scerri managed 9 handballs and no kicks this week but all were effective making it an ok score which also kept his BE low.

players.name: Thomas Edwards
players.note: Edwards made his BE but barely. Ideally he could be traded out as soon as you can with a new BE of 36.

players.name: Paddy Cross
players.note: Cross was brought in by a number of coaches in recent weeks but this was his second lowest score of the season from his 6 disposals and his BE is now up at 31 which is a concern.

players.name: Billy Cootee
players.note: Cootee played his second game and just the 11 disposals. He will be considered by many with a BE of 9 but his scoring won't see him generate much cash.

players.name: Liam Henry
players.note: Not a big day for Henry with 9 disposals at 55% with a couple of free kicks against.

players.name: Jack Watkins
players.note: Watkins was recalled to the team this week and he made the most of the chance and may have held his spot with his 20 disposals and 6 marks.

players.name: Oliver Greeves
players.note: Quiet game for Greaves and his lowest so far from his 16 disposals but just 68% effectiveness.

players.name: Xavier Bamert
players.note: Just 2 disposals and 2 marks for Bamert this week and he did drop a few marks. His spot in the side could be in jeopardy this week.

players.name: Tom Anastasopoulos
players.note: First game for Tom and he was ok with 16 disposals. It wasn't enough to go early on him but we may be in need of a rookie soon.

players.name: Mitch Zadow
players.note: 3 goals for Zadow from his 10 disposals saw his first score over 30 for the season. A great return but don't expect this every week.

players.name: Daniel Annable
players.note: Annable didn't have a big outing in his first game despite 13 disposals. Just the 2 were contested and 240m gained. We can wait another week yet but another game like this will mean he is a correction trade.

players.name: Thomas Burton
players.note: Burton had the 8 disposals and only just hit his BE. Unfortunately if you are holding him he isn't scoring enough and a new BE of 31 means he will likely lose money this week.

players.name: Harrison Oliver
players.note: Oliver was a late in when Whitfield and finished with 10 disposals to see his BE at -11 as he will play his third game when he is next in the team.

players.name: Lachy Dovaston
players.note: Dovaston is a must trade now. He just isn�t scoring enough to make any decent cash and you can't afford to be carrying him.

players.name: Bodie Ryan
players.note: Ryan didn't have a big impact on the game finishing with his score still not going over 45. Barely bench cover for you unfortunately.

players.name: Latrelle Pickett
players.note: Latrelle had an efficiency of just 53% and another low score. He is one to trade out.

players.name: Archer Reid
players.note: Wilmot was huge with 12 marks and 32 disposals. Easily his best of the year. But hold off until we see another game of this standard with his previous 5 only averaging 77.

players.name: Luker Kentfield
players.note: If not for the goal Kentfield's score would have been much lower. He isn't one to bring in just yet.

players.name: William McCabe
players.note: First game for McCabe with 4 marks and 6 disposals plus a goal. We will need to see more from him in game two before we jump aboard.

players.name: Jamarra Ugle-Hagan
players.note: Jamarra was a late out with an ankle injury.

players.name: Reilly O'Brien
players.note: O'Brien came into the side but played just 35% time on ground with 3 disposals and 15 hitouts. He had no impact on McAndrew's output.

players.name: Nic Martin
players.note: Martin is out for the season with a knee injury.

players.name: Tom Green
players.note: An ACL injury will see Green miss the entirety of the 2026 season

players.name: Jack Viney
players.note: Viney will be missing for a large part of the start of the year with an Achillies injury
